task.title: Adding a Game Capture Source
task.shortdesc: Capture a game at full frame rate with lower overhead than Window Capture.

context.p: Game Capture hooks directly into a game's rendering pipeline, which usually performs better than Window Capture for full-screen or borderless games.

step.cmd: In the Sources panel, click + and choose Game Capture.
Set Mode to Capture specific window or Capture any fullscreen application.
Launch or switch to the game.
Enable Allow Transparency if the game renders with an alpha channel and you need overlays to show through correctly.

taskbody.result: The game's output appears in the scene once OBS detects a matching window.
taskbody.postreq: See Troubleshooting: Dropped Frames if capture is choppy.
